meta.title: TK Reawakened — 3.1 command effect catalogue
source: spine AD-8, AD-9, AD-10, AD-17, AD-26
TK2 evidence: archive-org 2.20b help/rpgcodeEN.ref (language spec v2.1, list last updated for 2.19b)
meta.cleanRoom: No legacy source read (G7). TK2 command names taken from the shipped help file, which is an allowed artifact.
meta.note: Behaviour the docs do not state is marked [INFERENCE].

names.name: mwin
names.note: E-55; appends a line to the message window

names.name: winGraphic
names.note: file name implies an AD-17 asset request

names.name: text
names.note: tile-cell units; cnv selects a canvas

names.name: print
names.note: TK2 #Print draws at current text position

names.name: show
names.note: legacy: show a variable in the message window

names.name: get
names.note: non-blocking; consumes from the key queue [INFERENCE]

names.name: mouseClick
names.note: wait kind NOT in the AD-9 illustrative list

names.name: scan
names.note: 9.11 groups scan/mem under Input, but TK2 shows they stage board tiles (world)

names.name: createCursorMap
names.note: AD-10 puts cursor maps in ui (core/render), not input

names.name: cursorMapRun
names.note: returns the chosen index; wait kind inferred

names.name: mouseCursor
names.note: E-61 cursor image lives in ui

names.name: setImage
names.note: spelling confirmed by the TK2 ref (#SetImage)

names.name: forceRedraw
names.note: E-52; note that §9.10 says call it after ambient writes

names.name: drawEnemy
names.note: reads a .ene battle asset; draw-then-battle owner is ambiguous

names.name: send
names.note: kills board threads then transitions (E-19, AD-26)

names.name: getBoardTile
names.note: TK2 name is #GetBoardTile; 3.1 also has boardGetTile

names.name: tileType
names.note: 9.11 reads it as a query; TK2 #TileType SETS the type — conflict

names.name: prg
names.note: legacy: place a program on the board

names.name: addPlayer
names.note: asset request; roster lives in party (E-85)

names.name: newPlayer
names.note: swaps graphics; touches party and sprites

names.name: destroyPlayer
names.note: destroys the handle; also drops it from the roster

names.name: createItem
names.note: asset request; returns the slot number

names.name: itemCount
names.note: counts carried items, so it reads inventory (epic 8)

names.name: hp
names.note: stat globals named in the .tem file

names.name: giveExp
names.note: may level up, run the level-up program and bring up the battle rewards path (E-78)

names.name: inn
names.note: E-84 full restore (script may hold the inn thread)

names.name: equip
names.note: runs the equip program; stats move in vm.globals

names.name: attackAll
names.note: damage lands in vm.globals via StatsPort (AD-10)

names.name: applyStatus
names.note: loads a .ste file; status only in battle (AD-10)

names.name: menuGraphic
names.note: E-80 custom menu image; owner is menu (epic 8) despite the Battle group

names.name: rpgCode
names.note: executes a line in the current context

names.name: multiRun
names.note: AD-26: collects movement starts then yields one movement wait

names.name: mainFile
names.note: starts the game named by a .gam

names.name: gone
names.note: removes this program from the board

names.name: spliceVariables
names.note: expands <var> from globals, so it reads vm

names.name: log
names.note: must come from core/fmath, not Math.log (G3)

names.name: getTickCount
names.note: G3 bans Date/performance.now; use the injected clock (time.step)

names.name: openFileInput
names.note: AD-17 asset request; reads saves then shipped folders

names.name: underarrow
names.note: obsolete: raises an error and the statement is skipped

names.name: newplyr
names.note: docs/spec name; the earlier spelling is newPlayer, and newplayer is its alias

names.name: itemwalkspeed
names.note: obsolete: raises an error and the statement is skipped

names.name: shopcolors
names.note: obsolete from 3.1.0: shows a warning and still runs

languageLevelCommandsNotIn911.note: §9.6 remaps a function name globally, including built-ins

tk2Commands.note: places a blank line in the message window
add a party member from a .tem file
returns a value from a method
show a variable in the message window
